note: Adapted from the genus-level account in Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), whose description is itself adapted from Akhtar's 1975 original description; both the alate and the soldier are described and measured, the measurements being written into the descriptive sentences and reproduced here with mm added. Type locality Adampur, Bangladesh, the species being known only from the type locality.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head reddish brown, frons and postclypeus paler; labrum, legs and abdomen yellowish brown; antennae, pronotum and wings pale brown. Head and body sparsely hairy. Head capsule oval, slightly narrowed anteriorly, wider than long (head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.7 mm, head width including the compound eyes 2.01 mm); Y suture distinct. Compound eyes nearly circular (greatest diameter 0.64 mm, least diameter 0.59 mm), 0.04 mm from the antennae. Ocelli nearly oval (length 0.26 mm, width 0.21 mm), adjacent to and in broad contact with the eye facet. Postclypeus and frons not distinctly differentiated, a few hairs on the body and on the anterior margin of the postclypeus; anteclypeus trapezoidal, the anterior margin truncate and concave. Antennae 18-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Labrum wider than long with an almost straight anterior margin, a row of bristles near the anterior margin and a few hairs in the middle. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum almost rectangular (width 2.08 mm, length 1.03 mm), wider than the head width including the compound eyes; anterior margin concave, posterior margin incurved. Anterior margin of the wing with short hairs; the fore wing veins arise independently at the wing suture, the media and radius sector strongly sclerotized and parallel, the cubitus weak and unsclerotized. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, with arolia.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum pale reddish brown; frons and postclypeus darker; base of the mandibles reddish brown and the tip almost black; antennae reddish brown at the base and paler towards the tip; pronotum, abdomen and tibiae brownish yellow; femora and coxae whitish. Head sparsely hairy, the pronotum more densely so. Head capsule almost rectangular, far longer than wide (length to the base of the mandibles 3.63—3.99 mm, width 2.40—2.71 mm); widest in the posterior half, the sides almost parallel and converging anteriorly; frons sloping forwards; Y suture distinct. Compound eyes white, nearly oval (length 0.17—0.27 mm, width 0.10—0.17 mm), the narrow end downwards; eye-to-antenna distance 0.22—0.24 mm. Ocelli not visible. Labrum wider than long, the sides almost parallel, converging into a broadly rounded tip. Antennae 15—17-segmented; segment 3 strongly sclerotized and equal in length to segment 2; segment 4 the shortest. Postclypeus and frons undivided, with a few hairs; anteclypeus narrow and hairless. Mandibles short and stout, less than half the head length (mandible length 1.89—1.96 mm, mandible-to-head index 0.48—0.49); base raised; left mandible with 5 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum long (length 2.76—3.07 mm), clavate, broader in front (greatest width 0.76—0.87 mm) and weakly bilobed, then contracted into a long waist 0.35—0.42 mm wide. Pronotum almost rectangular, as wide as the head (width 2.37—2.71 mm, length 0.99—1.12 mm); anterior margin rather concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented.
